name: Optimised FSAE-style front corner (front-left)
description: Output of `suspkin optimize data/baseline_fsae_front.json data/optimize_front.json`. Roll-centre movement vs the chassis cut from -0.38 to -0.05 mm per mm of travel while keeping ball-joint spread and KPI close to the baseline, inside the 10 inch rim envelope.
coordinate_system: SAE/ISO vehicle axes: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up. Origin on the ground plane, on the car centerline, at the front axle line.

packaging._note: 10 inch rim envelope, checked in the wheel's own frame (see solver/suspkin/packaging.py)

point_descriptions.SHC: Spring/damper chassis end (direct-acting placeholder until the pushrod/rocker stage)
point_descriptions.RTO: Tie rod outer end (steering arm on the upright)
